arguments.sql:
WITH player_stint_highs AS (
    SELECT
        b.player_id,
        MAX(b.g) AS games_played,
        MAX(NULLIF(b.r, '')) AS runs,
        MAX(NULLIF(b.h, '')) AS hits,
        MAX(NULLIF(b.hr, '')) AS home_runs
    FROM main.batting AS b
    GROUP BY b.player_id
),
category_highs AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(games_played) AS games_played,
        MAX(runs) AS runs,
        MAX(hits) AS hits,
        MAX(home_runs) AS home_runs
    FROM player_stint_highs
),
leaders AS (
    SELECT 1 AS category_order, 'Games played' AS statistic, s.player_id, s.games_played AS score
    FROM player_stint_highs AS s
    JOIN category_highs AS c ON s.games_played = c.games_played

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 2, 'Runs', s.player_id, s.runs
    FROM player_stint_highs AS s
    JOIN category_highs AS c ON s.runs = c.runs

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 3, 'Hits', s.player_id, s.hits
    FROM player_stint_highs AS s
    JOIN category_highs AS c ON s.hits = c.hits

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 4, 'Home runs', s.player_id, s.home_runs
    FROM player_stint_highs AS s
    JOIN category_highs AS c ON s.home_runs = c.home_runs
)
SELECT l.statistic, p.name_given, l.score
FROM leaders AS l
JOIN main.player AS p ON p.player_id = l.player_id
ORDER BY l.category_order, p.name_given, l.player_id
LIMIT -1

WITH role_rank AS (
    SELECT
        pm.player_id,
        pm.role,
        SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY pm.player_id) AS total_matches_played,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY pm.player_id
            ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, pm.role
        ) AS role_rank
    FROM main.player_match AS pm
    GROUP BY pm.player_id, pm.role
),
deliveries AS (
    SELECT
        b.match_id,
        b.striker,
        b.bowler,
        COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0) AS runs_scored,
        CASE
            WHEN w.kind_out IN (
                'bowled', 'caught', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket', 'lbw', 'stumped'
            ) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS wicket_credited
    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
    LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s
        USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    LEFT JOIN main.wicket_taken AS w
        USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
),
batting_by_match AS (
    SELECT
        striker AS player_id,
        match_id,
        SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_scored,
        COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
    FROM deliveries
    GROUP BY striker, match_id
),
batting_career AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs_scored,
        MAX(runs_scored) AS highest_score,
        SUM(runs_scored >= 30) AS matches_with_30_plus,
        SUM(runs_scored >= 50) AS matches_with_50_plus,
        SUM(runs_scored >= 100) AS matches_with_100_plus,
        SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls_faced
    FROM batting_by_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals
    FROM main.wicket_taken
    WHERE kind_out <> 'retired hurt'
    GROUP BY player_out
),
bowling_by_match AS (
    SELECT
        bowler AS player_id,
        match_id,
        SUM(wicket_credited) AS wickets_taken,
        SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_conceded,
        COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled
    FROM deliveries
    GROUP BY bowler, match_id
),
bowling_career AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        SUM(wickets_taken) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS total_wickets_taken,
        6.0 * SUM(runs_conceded) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id)
            / SUM(balls_bowled) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS economy_rate,
        wickets_taken || '-' || runs_conceded AS best_bowling_performance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY player_id
            ORDER BY wickets_taken DESC, runs_conceded, match_id
        ) AS performance_rank
    FROM bowling_by_match
)
SELECT
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    r.role AS most_frequent_role,
    p.batting_hand,
    p.bowling_skill,
    COALESCE(b.total_runs_scored, 0) AS total_runs_scored,
    COALESCE(r.total_matches_played, 0) AS total_matches_played,
    COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS total_dismissals,
    1.0 * COALESCE(b.total_runs_scored, 0) / NULLIF(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS batting_average,
    b.highest_score,
    COALESCE(b.matches_with_30_plus, 0) AS matches_with_30_plus,
    COALESCE(b.matches_with_50_plus, 0) AS matches_with_50_plus,
    COALESCE(b.matches_with_100_plus, 0) AS matches_with_100_plus,
    COALESCE(b.total_balls_faced, 0) AS total_balls_faced,
    100.0 * b.total_runs_scored / NULLIF(b.total_balls_faced, 0) AS strike_rate,
    COALESCE(c.total_wickets_taken, 0) AS total_wickets_taken,
    c.economy_rate,
    c.best_bowling_performance
FROM main.player AS p
LEFT JOIN role_rank AS r ON r.player_id = p.player_id AND r.role_rank = 1
LEFT JOIN batting_career AS b ON b.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals AS d ON d.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowling_career AS c ON c.player_id = p.player_id AND c.performance_rank = 1
ORDER BY p.player_id
LIMIT -1

WITH role_counts AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           role,
           SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS total_matches_played,
           RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY player_id
               ORDER BY role IS NULL, COUNT(*) DESC
           ) AS role_rank
    FROM main.player_match
    GROUP BY player_id, role
),
appearances AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           GROUP_CONCAT(role, ', ') AS most_frequent_role,
           MAX(total_matches_played) AS total_matches_played
    FROM (
        SELECT player_id, role, total_matches_played
        FROM role_counts
        WHERE role_rank = 1
        ORDER BY player_id, role
    )
    GROUP BY player_id
),
batting_by_match AS (
    SELECT b.striker AS player_id,
           b.match_id,
           SUM(s.runs_scored) AS runs_scored,
           COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
    JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
),
batting_career AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs_scored,
           MAX(runs_scored) AS highest_score,
           SUM(runs_scored >= 30) AS matches_with_30_plus,
           SUM(runs_scored >= 50) AS matches_with_50_plus,
           SUM(runs_scored >= 100) AS matches_with_100_plus,
           SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls_faced
    FROM batting_by_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out AS player_id,
           COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals
    FROM main.wicket_taken
    WHERE kind_out <> 'retired hurt'
    GROUP BY player_out
),
bowling_by_match AS (
    SELECT b.bowler AS player_id,
           b.match_id,
           SUM(COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0)) AS runs_given,
           -- Count recorded deliveries for economy while ignoring the extra-runs data.
           COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN w.kind_out IN (
               'bowled', 'caught', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket', 'lbw', 'stumped'
           ) THEN 1 END) AS wickets_taken
    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
    LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    LEFT JOIN main.wicket_taken AS w USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id
),
bowling_career AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           wickets_taken || '-' || runs_given AS best_bowling_performance,
           SUM(wickets_taken) OVER player_matches AS total_wickets_taken,
           SUM(runs_given) OVER player_matches AS total_runs_given,
           SUM(balls_bowled) OVER player_matches AS total_balls_bowled,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY player_id
               ORDER BY wickets_taken DESC, runs_given, match_id
           ) AS performance_rank
    FROM bowling_by_match
    WINDOW player_matches AS (PARTITION BY player_id)
)
SELECT p.player_id,
       p.player_name,
       a.most_frequent_role,
       p.batting_hand,
       p.bowling_skill,
       COALESCE(bt.total_runs_scored, 0) AS total_runs_scored,
       COALESCE(a.total_matches_played, 0) AS total_matches_played,
       COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS total_dismissals,
       1.0 * COALESCE(bt.total_runs_scored, 0) / NULLIF(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS batting_average,
       bt.highest_score,
       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_30_plus, 0) AS matches_with_30_plus,
       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_50_plus, 0) AS matches_with_50_plus,
       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_100_plus, 0) AS matches_with_100_plus,
       COALESCE(bt.total_balls_faced, 0) AS total_balls_faced,
       100.0 * bt.total_runs_scored / NULLIF(bt.total_balls_faced, 0) AS strike_rate,
       COALESCE(bw.total_wickets_taken, 0) AS total_wickets_taken,
       6.0 * bw.total_runs_given / NULLIF(bw.total_balls_bowled, 0) AS economy_rate,
       bw.best_bowling_performance
FROM main.player AS p
LEFT JOIN appearances AS a ON a.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN batting_career AS bt ON bt.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals AS d ON d.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowling_career AS bw ON bw.player_id = p.player_id AND bw.performance_rank = 1
ORDER BY p.player_id

arguments.sql:
WITH metric_rows AS (
    SELECT m._year, m._month, m.month_year, m.interest_id, m.composition, m.index_value
    FROM main.interest_metrics AS m
    WHERE m._year * 100 + m._month BETWEEN 201807 AND 201908
),
map_counts AS (
    SELECT i.id, COUNT(*) AS name_rows, COUNT(i.interest_name) AS nonnull_names
    FROM main.interest_map AS i
    GROUP BY i.id
),
by_interest AS (
    SELECT m._year, m._month, m.interest_id,
           COUNT(*) AS metric_rows,
           SUM(m.composition IS NULL OR m.index_value IS NULL OR m.index_value = 0) AS undefined_ratios,
           SUM(m.month_year IS NOT printf('%02d-%04d', m._month, m._year)) AS month_label_mismatches,
           AVG(m.composition / NULLIF(m.index_value, 0)) AS ratio,
           COALESCE(i.name_rows, 0) AS name_rows,
           COALESCE(i.nonnull_names, 0) AS nonnull_names
    FROM metric_rows AS m
    LEFT JOIN map_counts AS i ON i.id = m.interest_id
    GROUP BY m._year, m._month, m.interest_id
)
SELECT _year, _month, SUM(metric_rows) AS metric_rows,
       COUNT(*) AS interests, MAX(metric_rows) AS max_rows_per_interest,
       SUM(undefined_ratios) AS undefined_ratios, SUM(month_label_mismatches) AS month_label_mismatches,
       SUM(name_rows = 0) AS interests_without_mapping,
       SUM(name_rows > 1) AS interests_with_duplicate_mapping,
       SUM(name_rows > nonnull_names) AS interests_with_null_name,
       MAX(ratio) AS top_ratio,
       SUM(ratio = monthly_max) AS interests_at_top
FROM (
    SELECT *, MAX(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY _year, _month) AS monthly_max
    FROM by_interest
)
GROUP BY _year, _month
ORDER BY _year, _month

           LAG(path, 2) OVER reverse_ties AS reverse_second_previous_path
    FROM main.activity_log

    WINDOW chronological AS (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, rowid),
           reverse_ties AS (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, rowid DESC)
)

GROUP BY path

GROUP BY path

FROM views

GROUP BY path

arguments.sql:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT s.prod_id,
           co.country_name AS country,
           t.calendar_month_number AS month,
           t.calendar_year AS year,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) AS sales_amount
    FROM main.sales AS s
    JOIN main.customers AS cu ON cu.cust_id = s.cust_id
    JOIN main.countries AS co ON co.country_id = cu.country_id
    JOIN main.times AS t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
    JOIN main.promotions AS p ON p.promo_id = s.promo_id
    JOIN main.channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = s.channel_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
      AND p.promo_total_id = 1
      AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
      AND t.calendar_year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, co.country_name, t.calendar_month_number, t.calendar_year
),
yearly_sales AS (
    SELECT prod_id, country, month,
           MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2019 THEN sales_amount END) AS sales_2019,
           MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2020 THEN sales_amount END) AS sales_2020,
           MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN sales_amount END) AS sales_2021
    FROM monthly_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, country, month
)
SELECT month,
       COUNT(sales_2019) AS groups_2019,
       COUNT(sales_2020) AS groups_2020,
       COUNT(sales_2021) AS groups_2021,
       SUM(sales_2019 IS NULL AND sales_2020 IS NOT NULL) AS no_2019_from_2020,
       SUM(sales_2019 = 0) AS zero_2019,
       SUM(sales_2019 IS NOT NULL AND sales_2020 IS NOT NULL AND sales_2021 IS NULL) AS paired_without_2021,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.currency AS fx
        WHERE fx.country = y.country AND fx.year = 2021 AND fx.month = y.month) AS fx_rows,
       (SELECT MIN(fx.to_us) FROM main.currency AS fx
        WHERE fx.country = y.country AND fx.year = 2021 AND fx.month = y.month) AS fx_rate
FROM yearly_sales AS y
GROUP BY country, month
ORDER BY month

WITH product_month_sales AS (
  SELECT s.prod_id, t.calendar_year AS sales_year, t.calendar_month_number AS month,
         SUM(s.amount_sold) AS amount
  FROM main.sales AS s
  JOIN main.customers AS c ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id
  JOIN main.countries AS co ON co.country_id = c.country_id
  JOIN main.times AS t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
  JOIN main.promotions AS p ON p.promo_id = s.promo_id
  JOIN main.channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = s.channel_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
    AND p.promo_total_id = 1 AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020, 2021)
  GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number
),
by_product_month AS (
  SELECT month, prod_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN sales_year = 2019 THEN amount END) AS sales_2019,
         MAX(CASE WHEN sales_year = 2020 THEN amount END) AS sales_2020,
         MAX(CASE WHEN sales_year = 2021 THEN amount END) AS sales_2021
  FROM product_month_sales
  GROUP BY month, prod_id
),
coverage AS (
  SELECT month,
         COUNT(sales_2019) AS products_2019,
         COUNT(sales_2020) AS products_2020,
         COUNT(sales_2021) AS products_2021,
         SUM(sales_2019 IS NOT NULL AND sales_2020 IS NOT NULL) AS paired_products,
         SUM(sales_2019 = 0 AND sales_2020 IS NOT NULL) AS zero_baselines,
         SUM(sales_2019 IS NOT NULL AND sales_2020 IS NOT NULL AND sales_2021 IS NULL) AS paired_without_2021,
         SUM(sales_2021 IS NOT NULL AND (sales_2019 IS NULL OR sales_2020 IS NULL)) AS actual_without_pair
  FROM by_product_month
  GROUP BY month
),
rates AS (
  SELECT month, COUNT(*) AS rate_rows, MIN(to_us) AS min_rate, MAX(to_us) AS max_rate
  FROM main.currency
  WHERE country = 'France' AND year = 2021
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT coverage.*, rates.rate_rows, rates.min_rate, rates.max_rate
FROM coverage
LEFT JOIN rates USING (month)
ORDER BY month

WITH product_month_sales AS (
    SELECT s.prod_id,
           t.calendar_year AS sales_year,
           t.calendar_month_number AS month,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) AS amount
    FROM main.sales AS s
    JOIN main.customers AS cu ON cu.cust_id = s.cust_id
    JOIN main.countries AS co ON co.country_id = cu.country_id
    JOIN main.times AS t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
    JOIN main.promotions AS p ON p.promo_id = s.promo_id
    JOIN main.channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = s.channel_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
      AND p.promo_total_id = 1
      AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020, 2021)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number
),
monthly_averages AS (
    SELECT target.month,
           ROUND(AVG(
               (
                   (recent.amount - prior.amount) / NULLIF(prior.amount, 0)
                   * recent.amount + recent.amount
               ) * COALESCE(fx.to_us, 1.0)
           ), 2) AS average_projected_sales_usd
    FROM product_month_sales AS target
    LEFT JOIN product_month_sales AS prior
      ON prior.prod_id = target.prod_id
     AND prior.month = target.month
     AND prior.sales_year = 2019
    LEFT JOIN product_month_sales AS recent
      ON recent.prod_id = target.prod_id
     AND recent.month = target.month
     AND recent.sales_year = 2020
    LEFT JOIN main.currency AS fx
      ON fx.country = 'France'
     AND fx.year = target.sales_year
     AND fx.month = target.month
    WHERE target.sales_year = 2021
    GROUP BY target.month
),
ranked_months AS (
    SELECT average_projected_sales_usd,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY average_projected_sales_usd) AS month_rank,
           COUNT(*) OVER () AS month_count
    FROM monthly_averages
    WHERE average_projected_sales_usd IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(average_projected_sales_usd) AS median_average_monthly_projected_sales_usd
FROM ranked_months
WHERE month_rank IN ((month_count + 1) / 2, (month_count + 2) / 2)
LIMIT 1

WITH product_month_sales AS (
    SELECT s.prod_id, t.calendar_month_number AS month, t.calendar_year AS year,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) AS sales
    FROM main.sales AS s
    JOIN main.customers AS cu ON cu.cust_id = s.cust_id
    JOIN main.countries AS co ON co.country_id = cu.country_id
    JOIN main.promotions AS p ON p.promo_id = s.promo_id
    JOIN main.channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = s.channel_id
    JOIN main.times AS t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
      AND p.promo_total_id = 1
      AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
      AND t.calendar_year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_month_number, t.calendar_year
),
year_pairs AS (
    SELECT prod_id, month,
           MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2019 THEN sales END) AS sales_2019,
           MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2020 THEN sales END) AS sales_2020,
           MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN sales END) AS sales_2021
    FROM product_month_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, month
),
history AS (
    SELECT month,
           COUNT(sales_2019) AS products_2019,
           COUNT(sales_2020) AS products_2020,
           COUNT(sales_2021) AS products_2021,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN sales_2019 = 0 THEN 1 END) AS zero_2019,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN sales_2019 <> 0 AND sales_2020 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS paired,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN sales_2019 <> 0 AND sales_2020 IS NOT NULL AND sales_2021 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS paired_with_2021
    FROM year_pairs
    GROUP BY month
),
rates AS (
    SELECT month, COUNT(*) AS rate_rows, COUNT(to_us) AS nonnull_rates,
           MIN(to_us) AS min_rate, MAX(to_us) AS max_rate
    FROM main.currency
    WHERE country = 'France' AND year = 2021
    GROUP BY month
)
SELECT h.*, r.rate_rows, r.nonnull_rates, r.min_rate, r.max_rate
FROM history AS h
LEFT JOIN rates AS r ON r.month = h.month
ORDER BY h.month

WITH product_month_sales AS (
    SELECT
        s.prod_id,
        co.country_name,
        t.calendar_year AS sales_year,
        t.calendar_month_number AS month,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) AS monthly_sales
    FROM main.sales AS s
    JOIN main.customers AS cu ON cu.cust_id = s.cust_id
    JOIN main.countries AS co ON co.country_id = cu.country_id
    JOIN main.promotions AS p ON p.promo_id = s.promo_id
    JOIN main.channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = s.channel_id
    JOIN main.times AS t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
      AND p.promo_total_id = 1
      AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
      AND t.calendar_year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, co.country_name, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number
),
product_month_history AS (
    SELECT
        prod_id,
        country_name,
        month,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sales_year = 2019 THEN monthly_sales END) AS sales_2019,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sales_year = 2020 THEN monthly_sales END) AS sales_2020
    FROM product_month_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, country_name, month
    HAVING MAX(sales_year) = 2021
),
projections AS (
    SELECT
        country_name,
        month,
        sales_2020 + (sales_2020 - sales_2019) / NULLIF(sales_2019, 0) * sales_2020
            AS projected_sales
    FROM product_month_history
)
SELECT

    ROUND(AVG(p.projected_sales * COALESCE(c.to_us, 1)), 2) AS avg_projected_sales_usd
FROM projections AS p
LEFT JOIN main.currency AS c
    ON c.country = p.country_name
   AND c.year = 2021
   AND c.month = p.month
GROUP BY p.month
ORDER BY p.month
LIMIT 1000

WITH RECURSIVE salary_characters (location, company_name, remaining_text, digits) AS (
    SELECT Location, CompanyName, Salary, ''
    FROM main.SalaryDataset
    WHERE Salary IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT location,
           company_name,
           SUBSTR(remaining_text, 2),
           digits || CASE
               WHEN SUBSTR(remaining_text, 1, 1) GLOB '[0-9]'
               THEN SUBSTR(remaining_text, 1, 1)
               ELSE ''
           END
    FROM salary_characters
    WHERE remaining_text <> ''
),
cleaned_salaries AS (
    SELECT location, company_name, CAST(digits AS REAL) AS salary_amount
    FROM salary_characters
    WHERE remaining_text = '' AND digits <> ''
),
country_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(salary_amount) AS average_salary
    FROM cleaned_salaries
),
company_location_averages AS (
    SELECT location, company_name, AVG(salary_amount) AS average_salary
    FROM cleaned_salaries
    WHERE location IN ('Mumbai', 'Pune', 'New Delhi', 'Hyderabad')
      AND company_name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY location, company_name
),
ranked_companies AS (
    SELECT location,
           company_name,
           average_salary,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY location
               ORDER BY average_salary DESC, company_name
           ) AS location_rank
    FROM company_location_averages
)
SELECT r.location AS "Location",
       r.company_name AS "Company Name",
       r.average_salary AS "Average Salary in State",
       c.average_salary AS "Average Salary in Country"
FROM ranked_companies AS r
CROSS JOIN country_average AS c
WHERE r.location_rank <= 5
ORDER BY r.location, r.location_rank
LIMIT 20

    SELECT i.product_id, i.purchased, SUM(i.qty) AS stocked_qty
    FROM main.inventory_with_dims AS i
    JOIN order_demand AS d ON d.product_id = i.product_id
    GROUP BY i.product_id, i.purchased
),
fifo_stock AS (
    SELECT product_id, purchased,
           COALESCE(SUM(stocked_qty) OVER (
               PARTITION BY product_id
               ORDER BY purchased
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
           ), 0) AS older_stock_qty
    FROM stock_by_purchase_date
)
SELECT pl.product_id, AVG(pl.qty) AS avg_units_picked
FROM main.picking_line AS pl
JOIN order_demand AS d ON d.product_id = pl.product_id
WHERE pl.order_id = 421
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM main.inventory_with_dims AS i
      JOIN fifo_stock AS f
        ON f.product_id = i.product_id AND f.purchased = i.purchased
      WHERE i.product_id = pl.product_id
        AND i.location_id = pl.location_id
        AND f.older_stock_qty < d.ordered_qty
  )
GROUP BY pl.product_id
ORDER BY pl.product_id
LIMIT 1000

WITH scores AS (
    SELECT name, version, step,
           MAX(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN test_score END) AS stack_score,
           MAX(CASE WHEN model <> 'Stack' THEN test_score END) AS other_score,
           SUM(CASE WHEN model = 'Stack' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stack_rows
    FROM main.model_score
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
step_results AS (
    SELECT m.name, m.version, m.step, m.L1_model,
           CASE WHEN s.stack_score > s.other_score THEN 'strong'
                WHEN s.stack_score = s.other_score THEN 'soft' END AS status
    FROM scores AS s
    JOIN main.model AS m USING (name, version, step)
    WHERE s.stack_score >= s.other_score
),
stored_only AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, L1_model, status FROM main.stack_ok
    EXCEPT SELECT name, version, step, L1_model, status FROM step_results
),
computed_only AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, L1_model, status FROM step_results
    EXCEPT SELECT name, version, step, L1_model, status FROM main.stack_ok
)
SELECT 'step results' AS check_name, L1_model, status, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM step_results GROUP BY L1_model, status
UNION ALL
SELECT 'model-status associations', L1_model, status, COUNT(*)
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT name, version, L1_model, status FROM step_results)
GROUP BY L1_model, status
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stored only', NULL, NULL, COUNT(*) FROM stored_only
UNION ALL
SELECT 'computed only', NULL, NULL, COUNT(*) FROM computed_only
UNION ALL
SELECT 'multiple Stack rows per step', NULL, NULL, COUNT(*) FROM scores WHERE stack_rows > 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'multiple L1 values per model', NULL, NULL, COUNT(*)
FROM (SELECT name, version FROM main.model GROUP BY name, version HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT L1_model) > 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'duplicate model step keys', NULL, NULL, COUNT(*)
FROM (SELECT name, version, step FROM main.model GROUP BY name, version, step HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'model with both statuses', NULL, NULL, COUNT(*)
FROM (SELECT name, version FROM step_results GROUP BY name, version HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT status) > 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'L1 mismatch against solution_ext', NULL, NULL, COUNT(*)
FROM step_results AS r
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM main.solution_ext AS e
    WHERE e.name = r.name AND e.version = r.version AND e.L1_model = r.L1_model

arguments.sql:
WITH helmet_status_by_collision AS (
    SELECT
        c.case_id,
        c.motorcyclist_killed_count,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN (
                'driver, motorcycle helmet used',
                'passenger, motorcycle helmet used'
            ) OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN (
                'driver, motorcycle helmet used',
                'passenger, motorcycle helmet used'
            ) THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) AS helmet_used,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN (
                'driver, motorcycle helmet not used',
                'passenger, motorcycle helmet not used'
            ) OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN (
                'driver, motorcycle helmet not used',
                'passenger, motorcycle helmet not used'
            ) THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) AS helmet_not_used
    FROM main.collisions AS c
    JOIN main.parties AS p ON p.case_id = c.case_id
    WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
      AND p.party_type IN ('driver', 'passenger')
    GROUP BY c.case_id, c.motorcyclist_killed_count
)
SELECT
    helmet_used,
    helmet_not_used,
    COUNT(*) AS collision_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT case_id) AS distinct_case_count,
    COUNT(motorcyclist_killed_count) AS known_fatality_counts,
    SUM(motorcyclist_killed_count) AS motorcyclist_fatalities
FROM helmet_status_by_collision
GROUP BY helmet_used, helmet_not_used
ORDER BY helmet_used DESC, helmet_not_used DESC

WITH helmet_parties AS (
    SELECT p.case_id, p.party_type, p.statewide_vehicle_type,
           p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet used')
               OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet used') AS used,
           p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet not used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet not used')
               OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet not used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet not used') AS not_used
    FROM main.parties AS p
    WHERE p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet%' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet%'
),
collision_counts AS (
    SELECT motorcycle_collision, COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT(DISTINCT case_id) AS cases,
           COUNT(*) - COUNT(motorcyclist_killed_count) AS missing_fatality_counts
    FROM main.collisions
    GROUP BY motorcycle_collision
),
helmet_cases AS (
    SELECT p.case_id, MAX(p.used) AS used, MAX(p.not_used) AS not_used
    FROM helmet_parties AS p
    JOIN main.collisions AS c ON c.case_id = p.case_id
    WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1 AND p.party_type IN ('driver', 'passenger')
    GROUP BY p.case_id
)
SELECT 'collision flag / case uniqueness / missing fatalities' AS diagnostic,
       CAST(motorcycle_collision AS TEXT) AS category, rows AS count_1, cases AS count_2,
       missing_fatality_counts AS count_3
FROM collision_counts
UNION ALL
SELECT 'party types with explicit helmet codes in motorcycle collisions', p.party_type, COUNT(*),
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.used THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN p.not_used THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM helmet_parties AS p
JOIN main.collisions AS c ON c.case_id = p.case_id
WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
GROUP BY p.party_type
UNION ALL
SELECT 'driver or passenger collision-level helmet statuses', 'used / not used / both',
       SUM(CASE WHEN used THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN not_used THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
       SUM(CASE WHEN used AND not_used THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM helmet_cases

WITH collision_helmet_use AS (
    SELECT
        c.case_id,
        c.motorcyclist_killed_count,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet used')
              OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet used')
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) AS helmet_used,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet not used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet not used')
              OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet not used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet not used')
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END) AS helmet_not_used
    FROM main.collisions AS c
    JOIN main.parties AS p ON p.case_id = c.case_id
    WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
      AND p.party_type IN ('driver', 'passenger')
    GROUP BY c.case_id, c.motorcyclist_killed_count
)
SELECT
    100.0 * SUM(motorcyclist_killed_count) FILTER (WHERE helmet_used = 1)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE helmet_used = 1), 0) AS helmet_used_fatality_pct,
    100.0 * SUM(motorcyclist_killed_count) FILTER (WHERE helmet_not_used = 1)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE helmet_not_used = 1), 0) AS helmet_not_used_fatality_pct
FROM collision_helmet_use
LIMIT 1

WITH appearances AS (
    SELECT r.year, r.round, p.driver_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.constructor_id) AS constructor_count, MIN(p.constructor_id) AS constructor_id
    FROM main.races AS r
    JOIN main.results AS p ON p.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, r.round, p.driver_id
),
season_appearances AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, MIN(round) AS first_appearance, MAX(round) AS last_appearance, COUNT(*) AS appearance_count
    FROM appearances
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
misses AS (
    SELECT a.year, a.driver_id, MIN(r.round) AS first_missed, MAX(r.round) AS last_missed, COUNT(*) AS missed_count
    FROM season_appearances AS a
    JOIN main.races AS r ON r.year = a.year AND r.round BETWEEN a.first_appearance AND a.last_appearance
    LEFT JOIN appearances AS p ON p.year = a.year AND p.round = r.round AND p.driver_id = a.driver_id
    WHERE p.driver_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY a.year, a.driver_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) < 3
),
season_sizes AS (
    SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM main.races GROUP BY year
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS eligible_breaks,
    SUM(m.last_missed - m.first_missed + 1 > m.missed_count) AS noncontiguous_breaks,
    SUM(b.constructor_count > 1 OR a.constructor_count > 1) AS ambiguous_constructors,
    SUM(s.race_count - p.appearance_count < 3) AS fewer_than_3_with_edges,
    SUM(s.race_count - p.appearance_count = m.missed_count) AS no_edge_absences,
    AVG(m.first_missed) AS avg_first_round,
    AVG(m.last_missed) AS avg_last_round,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT year) FROM main.races AS r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main.results AS p WHERE p.race_id = r.race_id)) AS years_with_resultless_races
FROM misses AS m
JOIN appearances AS b ON b.year = m.year AND b.driver_id = m.driver_id AND b.round = m.first_missed - 1
JOIN appearances AS a ON a.year = m.year AND a.driver_id = m.driver_id AND a.round = m.last_missed + 1
JOIN season_appearances AS p ON p.year = m.year AND p.driver_id = m.driver_id
JOIN season_sizes AS s ON s.year = m.year
WHERE b.constructor_id <> a.constructor_id
LIMIT 1

    FROM main.races AS r

    GROUP BY d.year, d.driver_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) < 3

    COUNT(*) AS bounded_driver_years,

    FROM main.races AS r
    JOIN main.results AS p ON p.race_id = r.race_id

driver_years AS (

),
missed_races AS (
    SELECT
        d.year,
        d.driver_id,
        MIN(r.round) AS first_missed_round,
        MAX(r.round) AS last_missed_round
    FROM driver_years AS d
    JOIN main.races AS r ON r.year = d.year
    LEFT JOIN appearances AS a

        AND a.driver_id = d.driver_id
        AND a.round = r.round
    WHERE a.driver_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY d.year, d.driver_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) < 3
)
SELECT
    AVG(m.first_missed_round) AS avg_first_round,
    AVG(m.last_missed_round) AS avg_last_round
FROM missed_races AS m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM appearances AS before_miss
    JOIN appearances AS after_miss
        ON after_miss.year = before_miss.year
        AND after_miss.driver_id = before_miss.driver_id
        AND after_miss.round = m.last_missed_round + 1
        AND after_miss.constructor_id <> before_miss.constructor_id
    WHERE before_miss.year = m.year
      AND before_miss.driver_id = m.driver_id
      AND before_miss.round = m.first_missed_round - 1
)

arguments.sql:
WITH appearances AS (
    SELECT r.year, s.driver_id, r.round,
           COUNT(DISTINCT s.constructor_id) AS constructors,
           MIN(s.constructor_id) AS constructor_id
    FROM main.results AS s
    JOIN main.races AS r ON r.race_id = s.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, s.driver_id, r.round
),
driver_seasons AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, MIN(round) AS first_appearance, MAX(round) AS last_appearance
    FROM appearances
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
recorded_races AS (
    SELECT r.year, r.round
    FROM main.races AS r
    WHERE r.race_id IN (SELECT race_id FROM main.results)
),
missed AS (
    SELECT d.year, d.driver_id, r.round,
           r.round BETWEEN d.first_appearance AND d.last_appearance AS is_internal
    FROM driver_seasons AS d
    JOIN recorded_races AS r ON r.year = d.year
    LEFT JOIN appearances AS a
      ON a.year = d.year AND a.driver_id = d.driver_id AND a.round = r.round
    WHERE a.driver_id IS NULL
),
candidate_bounds AS (
    SELECT 'all' AS race_scope, year, driver_id, MIN(round) AS first_missed, MAX(round) AS last_missed
    FROM missed
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) < 3
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'internal', year, driver_id, MIN(round), MAX(round)
    FROM missed
    WHERE is_internal
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) < 3
)
SELECT m.race_scope, COUNT(*) AS driver_years_with_appearances_at_both_ends,
       SUM(b.constructors > 1 OR a.constructors > 1) AS multiple_constructor_boundary_driver_years,
       SUM(b.constructor_id <> a.constructor_id) AS changed_single_or_min_constructor,
       AVG(CASE WHEN b.constructor_id <> a.constructor_id THEN m.first_missed END) AS avg_first,
       AVG(CASE WHEN b.constructor_id <> a.constructor_id THEN m.last_missed END) AS avg_last
FROM candidate_bounds AS m
JOIN appearances AS b ON b.year = m.year AND b.driver_id = m.driver_id AND b.round = m.first_missed - 1
JOIN appearances AS a ON a.year = m.year AND a.driver_id = m.driver_id AND a.round = m.last_missed + 1
GROUP BY m.race_scope

WITH demand AS (
    SELECT ol.product_id, COUNT(*) AS line_count, SUM(ol.qty) AS ordered_qty,
           MIN(ol.qty) AS smallest_line, GROUP_CONCAT(ol.id || '=' || ol.qty) AS order_lines
    FROM main.orderlines AS ol
    WHERE ol.order_id = 423
    GROUP BY ol.product_id
), stock AS (
    SELECT i.product_id, SUM(i.qty) AS inventory_qty, MIN(i.qty) AS smallest_lot,
           MIN(p.purchased) AS first_purchase, MAX(p.purchased) AS last_purchase,
           SUM(CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL OR p.product_id <> i.product_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_issues
    FROM main.inventory AS i
    JOIN main.locations AS l ON l.id = i.location_id
    LEFT JOIN main.purchases AS p ON p.id = i.purchase_id
    WHERE l.warehouse = 1
    GROUP BY i.product_id
)
SELECT d.*, s.inventory_qty, s.smallest_lot, s.first_purchase, s.last_purchase, s.purchase_issues
FROM demand AS d
LEFT JOIN stock AS s ON s.product_id = d.product_id
ORDER BY d.product_id

WITH line_demand AS (
    SELECT ol.id AS order_line_id,
           ol.product_id,
           ol.qty,
           SUM(ol.qty) OVER (
               PARTITION BY ol.product_id
               ORDER BY ol.id
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS demand_end
    FROM main.orderlines AS ol
    WHERE ol.order_id = 423
),
warehouse_stock AS (
    SELECT i.product_id,
           l.aisle,
           l.position,
           i.qty,
           SUM(i.qty) OVER (
               PARTITION BY i.product_id
               ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty, i.id
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS stock_end

WITH sales AS (
    SELECT product_code,
           COUNT(*) AS sale_rows,
           MIN(date) AS first_date,
           MAX(date) AS last_date,
           COUNT(sold_quantity) AS populated_quantities,
           SUM(sold_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM main.hardware_fact_sales_monthly
    WHERE date >= '2021-01-01' AND date < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY product_code
),
catalog AS (
    SELECT division, COUNT(*) AS catalog_rows,
           COUNT(DISTINCT product_code) AS catalog_codes,
           COUNT(DISTINCT product) AS catalog_product_names,
           COUNT(product) AS populated_product_names
    FROM main.hardware_dim_product
    GROUP BY division
),
matched AS (
    SELECT p.division, COUNT(*) AS matched_codes,
           COUNT(DISTINCT p.product) AS matched_product_names,
           SUM(s.sale_rows) AS matched_sale_rows,
           SUM(s.populated_quantities) AS populated_quantities
    FROM sales AS s
    JOIN main.hardware_dim_product AS p ON p.product_code = s.product_code
    GROUP BY p.division
)
SELECT c.*, m.matched_codes, m.matched_product_names, m.matched_sale_rows,
       m.populated_quantities,
       (SELECT SUM(sale_rows) FROM sales) AS total_sale_rows,
       (SELECT MIN(first_date) FROM sales) AS first_sale_date,
       (SELECT MAX(last_date) FROM sales) AS last_sale_date
FROM catalog AS c
LEFT JOIN matched AS m ON c.division IS m.division
ORDER BY c.division

arguments.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE daily_changes AS (
    SELECT
        t.customer_id,
        t.txn_date AS balance_date,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.txn_type = 'deposit' THEN t.txn_amount ELSE -t.txn_amount END) AS net_change
    FROM main.customer_transactions AS t
    GROUP BY t.customer_id, t.txn_date
),
customer_starts AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(balance_date) AS first_date
    FROM daily_changes
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
-- Carry balances forward through the last date in the transaction data.
calendar(balance_date) AS (
    SELECT MIN(balance_date) FROM daily_changes
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date(balance_date, '+1 day')
    FROM calendar
    WHERE balance_date < (SELECT MAX(balance_date) FROM daily_changes)
),
daily_balances AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        c.balance_date,
        strftime('%Y-%m', s.first_date) AS baseline_month,
        SUM(COALESCE(d.net_change, 0)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY s.customer_id
            ORDER BY c.balance_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS balance
    FROM customer_starts AS s
    JOIN calendar AS c ON c.balance_date >= s.first_date
    LEFT JOIN daily_changes AS d
        ON d.customer_id = s.customer_id AND d.balance_date = c.balance_date
),
rolling_balances AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', balance_date) AS month,
        baseline_month,
        AVG(balance) OVER last_30_days AS average_balance,
        COUNT(*) OVER last_30_days AS days_in_window
    FROM daily_balances
    WINDOW last_30_days AS (
        PARTITION BY customer_id
        ORDER BY balance_date
        ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    )
),
customer_monthly_maxima AS (
    SELECT customer_id, month, MAX(MAX(average_balance, 0.0)) AS maximum_average_balance
    FROM rolling_balances
    WHERE days_in_window = 30 AND month > baseline_month
    GROUP BY customer_id, month
)
SELECT month, SUM(maximum_average_balance) AS total_max_30_day_average_balance
FROM customer_monthly_maxima
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

arguments.sql:
WITH delivered_seller_orders AS (
    SELECT i.seller_id,
           o.order_id,
           o.customer_id,
           SUM(i.price - i.freight_value) AS order_profit
    FROM main.olist_orders AS o
    JOIN main.olist_order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY i.seller_id, o.order_id, o.customer_id
),
five_star_reviews_by_order AS (
    SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS review_count
    FROM main.olist_order_reviews
    WHERE review_score = 5
    GROUP BY order_id
),
seller_totals AS (
    SELECT d.seller_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS distinct_customers,
           SUM(d.order_profit) AS total_profit,
           COUNT(DISTINCT d.order_id) AS distinct_orders,
           SUM(COALESCE(r.review_count, 0)) AS five_star_ratings
    FROM delivered_seller_orders AS d
    LEFT JOIN main.olist_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN five_star_reviews_by_order AS r ON r.order_id = d.order_id
    GROUP BY d.seller_id
),
achievements AS (
    SELECT 1 AS category, 'Most distinct customer unique IDs' AS achievement,
           seller_id, distinct_customers AS value
    FROM seller_totals
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2, 'Highest profit', seller_id, total_profit
    FROM seller_totals
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 3, 'Most distinct orders', seller_id, distinct_orders
    FROM seller_totals
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 4, 'Most 5-star ratings', seller_id, five_star_ratings
    FROM seller_totals
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT category, achievement, seller_id, value,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY category ORDER BY value DESC, seller_id
           ) AS seller_rank
    FROM achievements
)
SELECT achievement, seller_id, value
FROM ranked
WHERE seller_rank = 1
ORDER BY category
LIMIT 4

WITH match_points AS (
    SELECT m.season, m.league_id, m.country_id,
           m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
           CASE
               WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
               WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
               ELSE 0
           END AS points
    FROM main."Match" AS m

    UNION ALL

    SELECT m.season, m.league_id, m.country_id,
           m.away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
           CASE
               WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3
               WHEN m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN 1
               ELSE 0
           END AS points
    FROM main."Match" AS m
),
team_season_points AS (
    SELECT season, league_id, country_id, team_api_id,
           SUM(points) AS total_points
    FROM match_points
    GROUP BY season, league_id, country_id, team_api_id
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT season, league_id, country_id, team_api_id, total_points,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY season ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS season_rank
    FROM team_season_points
)
SELECT r.season,
       t.team_long_name AS team_name,
       l.name AS league,
       c.name AS country,
       r.total_points
FROM ranked_teams AS r
JOIN main.Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = r.team_api_id
JOIN main.League AS l ON l.id = r.league_id
JOIN main.Country AS c ON c.id = r.country_id
WHERE r.season_rank = 1
ORDER BY r.season, t.team_long_name, l.name, c.name
LIMIT -1

WITH team_matches AS (
    SELECT
        season,
        league_id,
        country_id,
        home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        home_team_goal AS goals_for,
        away_team_goal AS goals_against
    FROM main."Match"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        season,
        league_id,
        country_id,
        away_team_api_id,
        away_team_goal,
        home_team_goal
    FROM main."Match"
),
season_points AS (
    SELECT
        season,
        league_id,
        country_id,
        team_api_id,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN goals_for > goals_against THEN 3
            WHEN goals_for = goals_against THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END) AS total_points
    FROM team_matches
    GROUP BY season, league_id, country_id, team_api_id
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT
        season,
        league_id,
        country_id,
        team_api_id,
        total_points,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY season
            ORDER BY total_points DESC
        ) AS points_rank
    FROM season_points
)
SELECT
    r.season,
    t.team_long_name AS team_name,
    l.name AS league,
    c.name AS country,
    r.total_points
FROM ranked_teams AS r
JOIN main.Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = r.team_api_id
JOIN main.League AS l ON l.id = r.league_id
JOIN main.Country AS c ON c.id = r.country_id
WHERE r.points_rank = 1
ORDER BY r.season, team_name, league, country

WITH monthly_nets AS (

        customer_id,
        date(txn_date, 'start of month') AS month_start,

closing_balances AS (

        month_start,

),

)

    FROM main.races
    WHERE year IN (1988, 2007)
    GROUP BY year
),
comparison AS (

    FROM last_rounds AS l

WITH order_ranges AS (
    SELECT
        ol.id AS order_line_id,
        ol.product_id,
        ol.qty AS required_qty,
        SUM(ol.qty) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ol.product_id
            ORDER BY o.ordered, o.id, ol.id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS order_end
    FROM main.orderlines AS ol
    JOIN main.orders AS o ON o.id = ol.order_id
),
inventory_ranges AS (
    SELECT
        i.product_id,
        i.qty AS available_qty,
        SUM(i.qty) OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.product_id
            ORDER BY pu.purchased, i.qty, i.location_id, i.id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS inventory_end
    FROM main.inventory AS i
    JOIN main.purchases AS pu ON pu.id = i.purchase_id
),
order_picks AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_line_id,
        o.product_id,
        o.required_qty,
        COALESCE(
            SUM(
                MIN(o.order_end, i.inventory_end)
                - MAX(o.order_end - o.required_qty, i.inventory_end - i.available_qty)
            ),
            0
        ) AS picked_qty
    FROM order_ranges AS o
    LEFT JOIN inventory_ranges AS i
        ON i.product_id = o.product_id
        AND i.inventory_end > o.order_end - o.required_qty
        AND o.order_end > i.inventory_end - i.available_qty
    GROUP BY o.order_line_id, o.product_id, o.required_qty
)
SELECT
    p.name AS product_name,
    AVG(100.0 * op.picked_qty / NULLIF(op.required_qty, 0)) AS avg_pick_percentage
FROM order_picks AS op
JOIN main.products AS p ON p.id = op.product_id
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY p.name
LIMIT -1

    FROM activity_log

       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM endpoint_ties) AS tied_endpoint_count
FROM activity_log
GROUP BY action

WITH airports AS (
    SELECT airport_code,
           json_extract(city, '$.en') AS city_name,
           radians(CAST(substr(coordinates, 2, instr(coordinates, ',') - 2) AS REAL)) AS longitude,
           radians(CAST(rtrim(substr(coordinates, instr(coordinates, ',') + 1), ')') AS REAL)) AS latitude
    FROM main.airports_data
),
flight_haversines AS (
    SELECT min(departure.city_name, arrival.city_name) AS city1,
           max(departure.city_name, arrival.city_name) AS city2,
           power(sin((arrival.latitude - departure.latitude) / 2.0), 2)
           + cos(departure.latitude) * cos(arrival.latitude)
             * power(sin((arrival.longitude - departure.longitude) / 2.0), 2) AS haversine
    FROM main.flights AS f
    JOIN airports AS departure ON departure.airport_code = f.departure_airport
    JOIN airports AS arrival ON arrival.airport_code = f.arrival_airport
),
pair_distances AS (
    SELECT city1, city2,
           avg(2.0 * 6371.0 * asin(sqrt(min(1.0, haversine)))) AS average_km
    FROM flight_haversines
    GROUP BY city1, city2
),
distance_ranges(lower_km) AS (
    VALUES (0), (1000), (2000), (3000), (4000), (5000), (6000)
),
range_counts AS (
    SELECT r.lower_km, count(p.average_km) AS pair_count
    FROM distance_ranges AS r
    LEFT JOIN pair_distances AS p
      ON p.average_km >= r.lower_km
     AND (r.lower_km = 6000 OR p.average_km < r.lower_km + 1000)
    GROUP BY r.lower_km
)
SELECT lower_km, pair_count,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM main.flights) AS total_flights,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM flight_haversines) AS joined_flights,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM pair_distances) AS distinct_pairs,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM pair_distances WHERE city1 = city2) AS same_city_pairs
FROM range_counts
ORDER BY lower_km

WITH airport_coordinates AS (
    SELECT airport_code,
           json_extract(city, '$.en') AS city,
           radians(CAST(substr(coordinates, 2, instr(coordinates, ',') - 2) AS REAL)) AS longitude,
           radians(CAST(rtrim(substr(coordinates, instr(coordinates, ',') + 1), ')') AS REAL)) AS latitude
    FROM main.airports_data
),
flight_distances AS (
    SELECT MIN(departure.city, arrival.city) AS city1,
           MAX(departure.city, arrival.city) AS city2,
           2.0 * 6371.0 * asin(sqrt(MIN(1.0,
               pow(sin((arrival.latitude - departure.latitude) / 2.0), 2)
               + cos(departure.latitude) * cos(arrival.latitude)
                 * pow(sin((arrival.longitude - departure.longitude) / 2.0), 2)
           ))) AS distance_km
    FROM main.flights AS flight
    JOIN airport_coordinates AS departure ON departure.airport_code = flight.departure_airport
    JOIN airport_coordinates AS arrival ON arrival.airport_code = flight.arrival_airport
),
city_pair_distances AS (
    SELECT city1, city2, AVG(distance_km) AS average_distance_km
    FROM flight_distances
    GROUP BY city1, city2
),
distance_ranges (lower_km, upper_km) AS (
    VALUES (0, 1000), (1000, 2000), (2000, 3000), (3000, 4000),
           (4000, 5000), (5000, 6000), (6000, NULL)
),
range_counts AS (
    SELECT distance_ranges.lower_km, COUNT(city_pair_distances.average_distance_km) AS pair_count
    FROM distance_ranges
    LEFT JOIN city_pair_distances
      ON city_pair_distances.average_distance_km >= distance_ranges.lower_km
     AND (city_pair_distances.average_distance_km < distance_ranges.upper_km
          OR distance_ranges.upper_km IS NULL)
    GROUP BY distance_ranges.lower_km
)
SELECT lower_km, pair_count
FROM range_counts
ORDER BY lower_km

WITH run_entries AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, runs_scored AS runs
    FROM main.batsman_scored
    UNION ALL
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, extra_runs AS runs
    FROM main.extra_runs
),
over_runs AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, SUM(runs) AS total_runs
    FROM run_entries
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
),
played_overs AS (
    -- Include every match with recorded deliveries.
    SELECT DISTINCT match_id, innings_no, over_id
    FROM main.ball_by_ball
),
ranked_overs AS (
    SELECT o.match_id, o.innings_no, o.over_id,
           COALESCE(r.total_runs, 0) AS total_runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY o.match_id
               -- Select the earliest over among equally high totals.
               ORDER BY COALESCE(r.total_runs, 0) DESC, o.innings_no, o.over_id
           ) AS over_rank
    FROM played_overs AS o
    LEFT JOIN over_runs AS r USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id)
)
SELECT w.match_id, w.innings_no, w.over_id, w.total_runs,
       (
           SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(bowler)
           FROM (
               SELECT DISTINCT b.bowler
               FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
               WHERE b.match_id = w.match_id
                 AND b.innings_no = w.innings_no
                 AND b.over_id = w.over_id
               ORDER BY b.bowler
           )
       ) AS bowler_ids,
       AVG(w.total_runs) OVER () AS avg_highest_over_runs
FROM ranked_overs AS w
WHERE w.over_rank = 1
ORDER BY w.match_id
LIMIT -1

WITH over_totals AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id,
           SUM(COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(e.extra_runs, 0)) AS total_runs,
           COUNT(DISTINCT b.bowler) AS bowler_count
    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
    LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)
    LEFT JOIN main.extra_runs AS e USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC, innings_no, over_id
    ) AS over_rank
    FROM over_totals
)
SELECT
    sqlite_version() AS sqlite_version,
    COUNT(*) AS matches_with_deliveries,
    SUM(m.match_id IS NULL) AS delivery_matches_outside_catalog,
    GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN m.match_id IS NULL THEN r.match_id END) AS match_ids_outside_catalog,
    SUM(r.bowler_count > 1) AS selected_overs_with_multiple_bowlers,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.batsman_scored AS s
     LEFT JOIN main.ball_by_ball AS b USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)
     WHERE b.match_id IS NULL) AS unmatched_batsman_entries,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.extra_runs AS e
     LEFT JOIN main.ball_by_ball AS b USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)
     WHERE b.match_id IS NULL) AS unmatched_extra_entries,
    AVG(r.total_runs) AS overall_average,
